name: lysine acetyltransferase 6B

function.text: KAT6B encodes histone acetyltransferase KAT6B. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and transcription coregulator activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include KAT6B-related multiple congenital anomalies syndrome (autosomal dominant); blepharophimosis - intellectual disability syndrome, SBBYS type (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: KAT6B–CREBBP rearrangements have been described in acute myeloid leukemia.
